data.content:
Here's what was implemented:

### Project Structure
```
TicketClassifier/
├── Models/
│   ├── TicketData.cs          # ML.NET input/output schema
│   ├── TicketRequest.cs       # API request DTO
│   ├── PredictionResult.cs    # Prediction response with confidence scores
│   └── EvaluationResult.cs    # Metrics response model
├── Services/
│   └── TicketClassifierService.cs  # ML pipeline: text featurization → SDCA MaxEntropy
├── Controllers/
│   └── TicketsController.cs   # API endpoints
├── Data/tickets.csv           # Training data (6 samples)
└── Program.cs                 # DI registration
```

### Endpoints
| Method | Route | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/tickets/classify` | Predicts category (Billing/Technical/General) with confidence scores |
| `GET`  | `/api/tickets/metrics`  | Returns macro/micro accuracy, log loss, per-category precision & recall |

### Pipeline
**Text featurization** on Subject + Description → **concatenated with Priority** → **SDCA Maximum Entropy** multiclass classifier. Input validation rejects empty tickets and out-of-range priorities (must be 1–3).
